class.name: HEGoCurveBuilder
class.brief_description: Converts the curve dictionaries a curve fetch returns into [Curve3D]s.
class.description: Pure geometry, no scene access: [HEGoCurveOutput] handles the nodes. A curve dictionary holds [code]positions[/code], [code]type[/code], [code]order[/code], [code]is_closed[/code] and, for NURBS, [code]knots[/code].

method.name: build
method.description: Builds the [Curve3D] matching [param curve]'s type, falling back to a poly curve for types this build does not know about.

method.name: curve_type_to_string
method.description: Name of a curve type, used to name generated nodes.

method.name: build_linear_curve
method.description: Poly curve: every control point becomes a [Curve3D] point.

method.name: build_nurbs_curve
method.description: NURBS curve, approximated by sampling. Curve3D's in/out handles cannot represent NURBS control points, so the curve is evaluated at a fixed number of parameter values and rebuilt from those samples.

method.name: evaluate_spline_at_t
method.description: Evaluates the B-spline defined by [param positions] and [param knots] at [param t_param].

method.name: compute_basis_functions
method.description: Cox-de Boor basis functions for the span [param k_param], returning [param order] weights.

method.name: generate_uniform_knots
method.description: Clamped uniform knot vector for [param num_control_points] points of [param order].

method.name: build_bezier_curve
method.description: Bezier curve: every third control point is on the curve, the two in between are its handles. Falls back to a poly curve when there are not enough points.

constants.constant: Category this file logs under, shown in the session panel filter.
Number of samples used for the shortest NURBS curves.
NURBS samples generated per control point, when that is more than [constant MIN_NURBS_SAMPLES].
Positions per Bezier segment in Houdini's flat control point list: one on-curve point followed by two off-curve handles.
